stopPolicy.action: abort known and late accepted turns; censor client observations; then durable cleanup
stopPolicy.unknownAdmissions: Durable account cleanup remains authoritative for admissions whose HTTP response failed.

originSampling.scope: before, during and after each stage; during samples run in the existing watcher, so intervals can exceed the target
originSampling.additionalQueries: Two per before/during sample; after reuses the existing post-stage status query.
